name: mcp-discovered-long-name
description: Settings -> MCP discovered-server row at phone widths: a long server name (hyphenated, or one unbroken token) wraps onto as many lines as it needs and is never clipped, since the row is read-only and a hover title is unreadable on touch; nothing spills out of the row.

mutation.declaration: panes/settings/sections/mcp.module.css: .serverName { white-space: normal } (deleted - the name inherits ListRow's nowrap label and every fixture fails as clipped); .serverName { overflow-wrap: anywhere } (deleted alone - fails the 320px unbroken-token fixture)
